seo.title: Family Church
seo.description: A community walking together in Christ, in faith, in family, in everyday life.

email.subject: Your sign-in link for Family Church
email.intro: Click the link below to sign in. It expires in 10 minutes.
email.footer: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

loginPage.heading: Sign in
loginPage.body: Enter your email address and we'll send you a sign-in link.
loginPage.footer: You need to be registered before you can sign-in. If you need access, please contact us.

checkEmailPage.heading: Check your email
checkEmailPage.body: If your email address is registered with our church, you'll receive a sign-in link shortly. The link expires in 10 minutes.

deniedPage.heading: Registration Required
deniedPage.body: You need to be registered for this content. Please contact us to arrange access.

expiredPage.heading: Link expired
expiredPage.body: This sign-in link is no longer valid — links expire after 10 minutes. Please request a new one.

announcements.title: New Website Launch
announcements.body: We're excited to launch our new website for 2027. The changes help us to make the very most of our content and to provide it in different mediums for different applications.
